question.text: In the EIC framework of fundamental analysis, scanning the macro-economic scenario first, then identifying promising industries, and finally selecting specific companies represents:

explanation.text: The Logic: The top-down approach starts with Economy (macro-economic analysis), moves to Industry analysis, and then Company analysis (EIC). The bottom-up approach reverses this — starting with company-specific factors and moving up to macro factors. The Trap: Bottom-up approach is the exact reverse — starting with company analysis and moving to macro factors. Cross-Exam Context: EIC framework and top-down vs bottom-up approaches are tested in X-A and V-A.
